finding: Star 5 Jun 1995 profile of the Riverdale Natural Law candidate: 'A French teacher, Cafe ran federally in 1993 under the same banner.' Star 22 Oct 1993 profile: a French teacher. The 1995 run is joined to the 1993 and 1997 federal runs. Only result tables were found for the 1999 Scarborough East run, which stays a separate Person.

Star 5 Jun 1995 profile of the Oakwood Libertarian: 'A pension administrator, Venuto tried for a federal seat in the 1993 election.' With the 1993 federal candidate shown to be the same man, the Davenport runs from 1999 to 2022 meet the same-office rule, which the same-name review had declined only because of that third Person. The held 2007 York South—Weston by-election run stays held.

Star 22 Oct 1993 (York Centre): 'The owner of a word processing and freelance writing and computer programming business'. Star 5 Jun 1995 (Dovercourt): 'Douglas Quinn, 30; Ltn. The owner of a computer business'.

Star 5 Jun 1995: 'John B. Steele, 54; Ind. A machinist and Communist League provincial secretary'. Star 3 Aug 2000 column on the Communist League's mayoral candidate: 'JOHN STEELE is, at 59' and he 'ran once before for mayor'. Ages agree and the 1995 ballot name fits the 2006 John Brian Steele. Nothing found on the held 2003 Parkdale—High Park run.

National Post 23 Mar 2006 on the Toronto-Danforth by-election: Cauchi 'ran in 2003 provincial election in the Davenport riding, receiving 264 votes to finish sixth in a seven- person race'. The held 2007 Eglinton—Lawrence run stays held.
Star 17 Oct 2006 on the open Ward 35 race: 'Elizabeth Moyer, 43, a long-time public school trustee, threw her hat into the ring'.

Star 6 Nov 2003 council guide, Ward 38: 'Political assistant to past councillor and MPP Brad Duguid ... Six years' experience at city hall plus prior work in event planning and media research.' Scarborough Mirror 27 Nov 2005: 'a former political aide at both city hall and Queen's Park'. CP24's 2022 Ward 23 guide quotes her website: a 'communications, media, community and government relations, event planning' and emergency management specialist. The same-name review's reading of her 2017 Scarborough Mirror answers (an assistant to Scarborough politicians) could not be checked in ProQuest and is not relied on.

Star 6 Nov 2003 trustee guide, TDSB Ward 22: 'A respiratory therapist, Kwok, 31'. Star 11 Feb 2017: 'Kingsley Kwok, a respiratory therapist'. Elections Canada's 2021 return names him Kingsley Arnold Kwok.
